notes.title: Touhou : ShootingStar ver3.0
notes.content:
[h2]New Enemies "Sanae Kotiya" and "Utsuho Reiuji"[/h2]
A new enemy will be added to the Eastern Meteor Tale, one that can do battle in a barrage!

[h3]Sanae Kotiya[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37875642/e8c4a45b57b158bf94b9ebb6fd68de27930cd35b.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37875642/965a7c6f2354539dc40f228058719bfc5dd43339.png[/img]

[h3]Utsuho Reiuji[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37875642/1e55b44f0b91edc153d3416ebd990a0d60225c26.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37875642/9b5b327b03f44f25f87b3895f964f8d1a00ddd73.png[/img]

[h2]New base, "Village at the Foot of the Mountain"[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37875642/15d89c47a942beb8b41a3cf908ebc26294ba6d2d.png[/img]
Marisa and Reimu have set up a base near the mountain of demons to deal with the new anomaly!

[h2]New quests, new stories[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37875642/73ccd5b7b1f695b54804441bca69618f331ac282.png[/img]
The meteor has appeared again in the Mountain of Monsters!
Thinking that the Moriya Shrine is up to something again, Reimu and I head for the Shrine, but it seems that the source of the meteor's energy is underground, so we have to go underground. ......

[h2]New Equipment[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37875642/3d5659d81c588679c5234b38d5edac2402d5deeb.png[/img]
New weapons and armor added!
New armor comes with distinctive skills!
With a stronger Marisa, take on stronger enemies!


[h2]New stages[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37875642/aa45f74d68b8dcfe15d47fbb7c28a25aeabf1633.png[/img]
Added Moriya Shrine Road, Underground Volcano, and Lava Cave!

[h2]Easier to use UI[/h2]

The UI system has been completely redesigned.
[h2]Improved usability, especially with controllers.


[h1]What is Touhou : Shooting Star [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37875642/7f0a80c340bd1d5cf47809d045d42c39d1d5b780.png[/img]
You control Marisa Kirisame, an ordinary wizard, and fly around the fantasy land!
The 2D shooting game "Touhou Project" has been recreated in 3D!
The game is a 3D recreation of the 2D shooting game "Touhou Project".

[h2]Recreate Touhou's bullet screen in 3D! [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37875642/b8d75adbef4b336dbe356db796883214f1d6099b.png[/img]

[h2]Equipment Development[/h2]
You can develop stronger weapons, armor, and spell cards from the materials of the enemies you defeat. Come up with your own unique combination of equipment!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37875642/30aa4c4f1e6de9d56993974284af9c38daac2f55.png[/img]

[h2]Challenging Quests[/h2]
There are over 30 quests in the collection, and over 10 enemy boss characters! In addition, there are sub-goals for each quest, and the rewards increase accordingly.
In addition, there are sub-goals for each quest, and the rewards increase accordingly. Sub-goals are recorded, so you can clear quests with no damage, go on time attacks, get all the spell cards, and more!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37875642/5184536f4b62a7219bd748bc96fc20bec91c19b4.png[/img]

[h2]Dress-up system[/h2]
Depending on your level of skill, you can change Marisa's clothes! Fly through the skies of Fantasyland in your favorite outfit!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37875642/bcf11c7312b6bec0b7550a5b29121a11f38265ef.png[/img]

notes.title: Touhou : Shooting Star ver1.3 Update
notes.content:
Touhou : Shooting Star "Version 1.3" has been released.

The additional elements and changes are as follows
New Stage "Foothills of the Monster
New Boss "Kawashiro Nitori".
Added BGM for the above two stages.
New equipment will be added as rewards for clearing the above two stages.
Added a ranking function to the Challenge Quests.
New costumes added to the boutique
Correction of radar.
Other minor modifications

Also, with the implementation of the ranking feature in version 1.3, the formula for calculating scores has been revised. Since the player's map displays the high score including previous versions, [b]The high score of the ranking function may not match the high score displayed on the player's map.
[/b]
Also, the ranking function is only available for Challenge Quests. Challenge Quests can be ordered from the rally hall.

About Challenge Quests
Challenge Quests are quests that can be ordered at the rally hall.
Enemies are more durable and have higher attack power than normal.
There are more rewards than normal quests.
There are quests that give you special rewards.
There is a maximum cost limit.
This is one of the characteristics of the game. In particular, in order to meet the maximum cost limit, the maximum rarity of the equipment must be below a certain level. Please note that if you don't meet this requirement, you will not be able to accept Challenge Quests. Equipment can be changed in the "Equipment Change Node" on the right side of the quest board in the Assembly Hall.


Ranking Function

notes.title: [In development] ver1.3 Update
notes.content:
I'm the developer's representative. Thank you for playing Touhou : Shooting Star.

Now, Touhou Meteor Tan is in the process of developing a mid-scale update, version 1.3.
The new additions are :
-New Stage "Foothills of the Monster
-New Boss "Kawashiro Nitori".
-Added BGM for the above two stages.
-New equipment will be added as rewards for clearing the above two stages.
-Added a ranking function to the Challenge Quests.
-New costumes added to the boutique
-Other minor modifications

Development is progressing well and if all goes as planned, we will be able to release the game within two weeks.
We are looking forward to having you all play the game as we develop it.

If you have any comments or reviews about the game, or if you have any opinions about glitches, problems, or elements you would like to see fixed or added to the game, we would appreciate it if you could leave a comment or review.


-New Costumes

notes.title: Update: Challenge Quests (ver 1.2f18)
notes.content:
If you open the map during a challenge quest, the map will now open during the challenge quest.
Also, if a player is defeated in a challenge quest, they will now be moved to the meeting place instead of the human village.
Other minor fixes.

notes.title: About new version : fixed bugs
notes.content:
Patch 1.2f16 has been released which fixes some bugs.

Adjustment of the UI
Fixed an issue where the translation was not applied to the Tenshi fight.
Fixed a problem with the display when the number of hits is large.
Fixed a bug that caused footsteps to be heard while loading.
Corrects and adjusts some of the attacks on advanced Flanders.
Fixed a bug that prevented some achievements from being released.
Fixed other problems


How to get the results that were not cancelled
-The "defeating Reimu" will be canceled by defeating the lower level Reimu again.
- "Challenger" is to complete one of the challenge quests again on a difficulty level of 10 or less. This is released by


We apologize for any inconvenience this bug may cause players.
We will continue to update this game to make it even better in the future.
